author: IGN
description:
We’ve survived the horrors of Resident Evil Requiem to bring you a look at every possible outcome for this survival horror epic. This video contains the full sequences for both the Good and Bad endings, including the final decisions and post-credits scenes that determine the fate of the cast. Major spoilers follow, so we recommend finishing your first playthrough before diving in to see how your choices could have changed the finale.

title: Resident Evil Requiem - Every Ending (4K) | SPOILERS!

author: IGN
description:
There are plenty of brand-new weapons to unlock in Resident Evil Requiem. Whether you play as Grace Ashcroft or Leon Scott Kennedy, you'll have access to a deadly assortment of unlockable guns throughout RE Requiem, from Leon's iconic Maltilda IMP to the deadly RPG-7, the powerful Requiem magnum revolver, and more. 

This is our gameplay showreel of every unlockable and fireable gun in RE9, all with infinite ammo and every upgrade applied to them. Don't worry, we've included the reload animations in both first- and third-person as well!

#IGN #ResidentEvilRequiem #AllWeapons
title: Every Unlockable Weapon In Resident Evil Requiem

author: IGN
description:
So you’ve survived the horrors of Resident Evil Requiem and escaped the latest nightmare—but the credits aren't the end of the road. Whether you’re hunting for the elusive New Game Plus mode, trying to figure out how to spend your hard-earned Challenge Points, or wondering if The Mercenaries made the cut this time around, we’ve got you covered. This spoiler-free guide breaks down every post-game unlock, from Leon’s Tactical Tracker to the terrifying Insanity difficulty setting.

Resident Evil Requiem offers plenty of reasons to head back into the fray, including secret endings and high-tier rewards like infinite ammo. We dive into the "Grace’s Report" lore documents, explain how to farm Challenge Points for alternate costumes, and detail how to trigger the true final boss fight without restarting your entire playthrough. For more Resident Evil tips, boss guides, and the full wiki, be sure to head over to IGN.

title: Resident Evil Requiem Post-Game Guide: Endgame, NG+, and Replayability

author: IGN
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for The Abased, a Bible-inspired fantasy action RPG where you play as Elyhias, a leper and fallen faith enforcer marked by affliction. Armed with slings and blades, you must face the resurgent giants who once ruled the ancient land. In exchange, you are promised atonement and cleansing before your flesh succumbs to abasement. The Abased will be available on PC soon.

description:
Right at the end of Resident Evil Requiem, you’re presented with a choice to seal the fates of Grace and Leon. There are two options: Destroy Elpis or Release Elpis, and one is certainly much less desirable than the other. 

If you’d like to know about the ending you didn’t choose, you’re in the right place. In this ending explained video, you can see both endings play out, so let’s dive in and explain both of Requiem's conclusions.
